title: Circular - Gujarati Translation of Supreme Court Judgments on Gujarat High Court website
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 30-03-2023 REGISTRAR GENERAL

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
C I R C U L A R
Launch of dedicated section on Gujarat High Court website
for Gujarati Translated version of Orders/Judgments
of Hon’ble the Supreme Court of India
As directed, this is to convey for the benefit of all the stakeholders that,
based on the guidance from the Hon'ble AI Assisted Legal Translation Advisory
Committee of Hon’ble the Supreme Court of India and directions and approval of
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. J. Desai, the Acting Chief Justice of High Court of Gujarat
and the Hon’ble Judges of the I. T. Committee & AI Assisted Translation
Monitoring Committee of the High Court of Gujarat; a dedicated section has been
created in the website of the High Court of Gujarat for publishing Gujarati
translated versions of orders/judgments of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India.
Under this new section on the homepage of the High Court website, the
Translation Cell of the High Court of Gujarat would be directly uploading the
Gujarati version of the orders/judgments through a software mechanism
developed by the IT Cell of the High Court. The English version would also be
directly accessible from this section for ready reference of the users for accessing
the original version of the orders/judgments.
https://gujarathighcourt.nic.in/scgujaratijudgments
To begin with, 6 translated orders/judgments of Supreme Court matters
originating from Gujarat involving public/social interests and other aspects
therein, have been uploaded after due verification, with assistance from the
Gujarat State Judicial Academy (GSJA). As part of ongoing translation exercise
being undertaken at the High Court of Gujarat under active monitoring of the
Hon’ble Judges of the AI Assisted Translation Monitoring Committee of the High
Court of Gujarat, translation of orders/judgments of Hon’ble the Supreme Court
of India would be regularly and gradually made available under this section.
Sd/-
Date: 30-03-2023 REGISTRAR GENERAL
